basic_details.job_title: PM SHRI KV EAC Upper Shillong PGT -Economics Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya EAC Upper Shillong (Shillong, Meghalaya) is engaging one PGT-Economics teacher purely on contractual basis for the academic session 2026-27, through a walk-in interview on 27 November 2026 (Friday) from 8:30 am. Eligibility is as per KVS latest eligibility rules, and remuneration is as per KVS norms. Only candidates who register online on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal by 26 November 2026 will be allowed to appear for the interview.

how_to_apply: Only online registration through the KVS Samvida Sathi (SAMAGAM) portal is accepted for this walk-in interview.
Register online on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal at https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ (the notice also lists https://eacuppershillong.kvs.ac.in/ for online registration).
Upload the soft copy of your certificates at the time of registration; this is mandatory.
Complete the registration on or before 26 November 2026.
Report at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, EAC Upper Shillong on 27 November 2026 from 8:30 am onwards.
Produce the documents listed below on the day of the interview.
A set of self-attested photocopies of these documents
The notice also states that only shortlisted candidates will be asked to produce their supporting documents on the day of the interview.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates will be debarred from appearing in the interview or joining service if the documents are not produced or if the information provided is found wrong. Unregistered candidates will not be allowed to appear for the interview. For any assistance, contact 8787362955. The school's phone number is 0364-2560973, fax 0364-2561205 and e-mail [email protected]. For detailed information and other details, the notice refers candidates to the school website https://eacuppershillong.kvs.ac.in.

content_sections.heading: About PM SHRI KV EAC Upper Shillong
content_sections.text: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya EAC Upper Shillong is a Kendriya Vidyalaya located at Post: Nonglyer, East Khasi Hills, Shillong, Meghalaya – 793009. Its School Code is 39328 and its CBSE Registration No. is 1300003. The school is holding this walk-in interview to draw a reserve panel of candidates for engagement on contractual basis for the academic session 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The eligibility for the PGT-Economics post is as per KVS latest eligibility rules. The notice does not print the qualification itself and refers candidates to the KVS official website ( https://kvsangathan.nic.in/ ) for detailed information on eligibility criteria. Desirable: Knowledge for Computer Applications and proficiency to teach in English and Hindi. Relaxation: Where suitable candidates with B.Ed. are not available for PGT, relaxation may be provided as per extant rules of KVS. Registration: All eligible candidates must mandatorily register online on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal; unregistered candidates will not be allowed to appear for the interview. The notice does not mention an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification and the KVS eligibility rules for the discipline-specific eligibility of the PGT-Economics post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration and working hours for the PGT-Economics teacher are as per KVS norms; the notice prints no amount. The engagement is purely part-time contractual for the academic session 2026-27, and the interview will draw a reserve panel of candidates. The engagement can be terminated as and when the post is filled by a regular incumbent, if the service is not satisfactory, when the service is no more required, or without giving any reason. The post will not be regularised in any case.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PM SHRI KV EAC Upper Shillong PGT -Economics
content_sections.text: Only online registration through the KVS Samvida Sathi (SAMAGAM) portal is accepted for this walk-in interview. Register online on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal at https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ (the notice also lists https://eacuppershillong.kvs.ac.in/ for online registration). Upload the soft copy of your certificates at the time of registration; this is mandatory. Complete the registration on or before 26 November 2026. Report at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, EAC Upper Shillong on 27 November 2026 from 8:30 am onwards. Produce the documents listed below on the day of the interview. Registration form duly filled up 2 recent passport size photographs Original testimonials A set of self-attested photocopies of these documents The notice also states that only shortlisted candidates will be asked to produce their supporting documents on the day of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the PGT-Economics post is through a personal interview. Date: 27 November 2026 (Friday) Reporting time: From 8:30 am onwards Place of interview: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, EAC Upper Shillong Mode: Personal Interview

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates will be debarred from appearing in the interview or joining service if the documents are not produced or if the information provided is found wrong. Unregistered candidates will not be allowed to appear for the interview. For any assistance, contact 8787362955. The school's phone number is 0364-2560973, fax 0364-2561205 and e-mail [email protected] . For detailed information and other details, the notice refers candidates to the school website https://eacuppershillong.kvs.ac.in .
